title: English punctuation runtime implementation (kredor INT8 ONNX)

runtime_artifact.name: punct-en-kredor

sentencepiece.bpe.model.provenance: xlm-roberta-base SPM, pinned (kredor is an xlm-roberta-base fine-tune, tokenizer unchanged)

conversion.path: torch.onnx.export (opset 17) -> onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic (QInt8, weight-only dynamic, no calibration set)
conversion.script: WSL ~/m50/convert.py (reproducible: export -> quantize -> tokenizer equivalence -> INT8 predictions -> perf -> provenance)

runtime_artifact.tokenizer_id_law: fairseq offset: hf_id = spm_id + 1; spm-unk -> 3; <s>=0 </s>=2 <pad>=1 (0 mismatches over 1218 unique eval words)
runtime_artifact.fp32_int8_agreement: 80/120 eval rows byte-identical text; corpus metrics within noise of M49 fp32

shipped_stage.flag: INTELLIAI_STT_PUNCTUATION_EN_ENABLED (default FALSE everywhere; production stays OFF)

gates.quality: evidence/quality-shipped-stage.json (frozen en-punct-eval@v1, ruler punct_slots@v1, invariant 0 failures)
gates.long_transcripts: evidence/long-transcripts.json (up to 1500 words, zero word changes)

boss_audio.note: same 102 s founder clip as M48; audio itself never enters git

sarvam_note: Sarvam remains QUALITATIVE ONLY (M48 directive): no Sarvam metrics are reported anywhere in M50; the readability comparison uses the captured Sarvam output as a qualitative benchmark of 'punctuated formatting exists'.

environment.service: intelliai-stt-runtime uvicorn dev instances on ports 8791-8793 (demo docker stack untouched)
